outcome: neurodevelopmental impairment at 18 to 22 months' corrected age or death before assessment (composite outcome)
necrotizing enterocolitis or death and severe intraventricular hemorrhage or death (combined outcomes)
cohort: The study included 6925 multiple-birth infants with a gestational age between 22 and 28 weeks, born at a National Institute of Child Health and Human Development Neonatal Research Network center between January 1998 and December 2013.
finding: Exposure to antenatal corticosteroids was associated with a lower risk of mortality in extremely preterm multiples, with no significant differences in the composite of neurodevelopmental impairment or death, compared to no exposure.
